```{r}
#| include: false
pkgload::load_all(Sys.getenv("APATABLES_PKG_ROOT"), quiet = TRUE)
blk1 <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay, data = album)
blk2 <- lm(sales ~ adverts + airplay + attract, data = album)
reg_tbl <- apa.reg.table(blk1, blk2, table.number = 2)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-reg
#| tbl-cap: "Hierarchical Multiple Regression Predicting Sales"
#| apa-note: "N = 200."
apa.quarto.pdf(reg_tbl)
```
